description: Backup/Restore (disaster recovery) is intentionally unsupported in Iridium. BACKUP and RESTORE statements are lexically accepted but fail at parse/execution time. The differential harness asserts phase7_admin_classification failures.
status_note: Iridium does not support BACKUP/RESTORE. The UI menu should be disabled via capability probes. The disaster recovery entry in the harness verifies the statement is rejected.
